179.description: This vector represents acronyms and abbreviations commonly used in Hindi-language contexts, such as organization names and political entities.

186.description: These tokens represent fragments and characters from Hindi script.

56.description: This vector represents subword tokens and character fragments from North Indian scripts like Hindi.

75.description: This vector activates for Hindi vowel sign combining characters followed by a comma punctuation mark.

122.description: This vector represents subword tokens and character sequences commonly found in Indic scripts, particularly Hindi/Devanagari text.

180.description: This vector activates for common character sequences and phonemes in Indic and Indo-Aryan languages.

124.description: This vector activates on Hindi script suffixes and Hindi text tokens alongside variations of the word "artificial".

78.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi suffixes and word fragments ending in nasal or plosive consonants.

39.description: This feature vector activates strongly on Hindi Devanagari vowel sign "i" (ि) and its combinations with various consonants.

96.description: These tokens represent common Hindi dependent vowel signs (matras) and consonant-vowel conjuncts frequently occurring in text tokenization.
